card.name: First word right after a section heading
card.fires_on: The first word of body text that comes straight after a section heading, with no punctuation between. Often it repeats the heading's topic, such as Serious, Premature or Adenosine.

modes.label: Serious after warning headings
modes.description: The word Serious begins the paragraph right after a numbered warning heading.
modes.example: 5.1 Hypersensitivity Reactions Including Anaphylaxis<< Serious>> hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphyl

modes.label: Drug or topic name restated
modes.description: The first word of the paragraph restates the heading's subject, often as the start of a drug name or lab term.
modes.example: 7.2 Effects of Adenosine Injection on Other Drugs<< Ad>>enosine injection has been given with other

card.plain: It marks the first word of a paragraph that follows a heading in a drug label, when the text repeats the heading's topic.
